{{< include r_1.html >}}

# R chunk to create DuckDB data connection using local file

{{< include r_2.html >}}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| context: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Create a DuckDB connection
disaster_data<-readxl::read_xlsx("public_emdat.xlsx")
db1<-dbConnect(duckdb(),)
dbWriteTable(db1,"natural_disaster",disaster_data)
db2<-dbConnect(duckdb(),"disaster.duckdb")
dbWriteTable(db2,"natural_disaster",disaster_data)
dbDisconnect(db2, shutdown = TRUE)
```
# SQL chuck to display selected columns from the natural disaster database
{{< include r_3.html >}}
```{sql}
--| echo: false
--| connection: db1
--| tblestyle: striped
--| tbl-cap: "Table-1: First 5 rows of data"
SELECT 
    Country,
    "Start Year",
    "End Year",
    "Total Affected"
FROM natural_disaster
LIMIT 5;
```
# SQL chunk to filter data and save as R dataframe
{{< include code_chunk_5.html >}} 

```{sql}
--| connection: db1
--| output.var: disaster_brics
--| echo: false
SELECT
    Country,
    "Start Year",
    SUM("Total Deaths") AS total_deaths
FROM natural_disaster
WHERE Country IN (
    'Brazil',
    'India',
    'China',
    'South Africa',
    'Russian Federation'
)
GROUP BY
    Country, "Start Year"
ORDER BY
    Country, "Start Year";
```

# GGSQL chunk for scatter plot using R dataframe
{{< include sql_1.html >}}

```{ggsql}
#| echo: false
SELECT
    LN("Total Damage ('000 US$)" + 1) AS cost,
    LN("Total Affected" + 1) AS affected,
    "Start Year",
    "Total Affected",
    "Total Deaths",
    "Country",
    "Disaster Subgroup"
FROM r:disaster_data
WHERE Country IN (
    'Brazil',
    'India',
    'China',
    'South Africa',
    'Russian Federation'
)
AND  "Start Year" in (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)
VISUALIZE
    cost AS x,
    affected AS y
DRAW point
MAPPING
    Country AS stroke,
    Country AS fill
SETTING
      size => 5
DRAW text
MAPPING
        "Disaster Subgroup" AS label
SETTING
    fontsize => 4,
      vjust=>1
LABEL
    title => 'Log(Total Damage) vs Log(Total Affected)'
```

# GGSQL chunk for bar plot using DuckDB
{{< include sql_2.html >}}
```{ggsql} 
#| connection: "duckdb://./disaster.duckdb"
#| echo: false
    FROM natural_disaster
    WHERE Country IN (
    'Brazil',
    'India',
    'China',
    'South Africa',
    'Russian Federation'
)
VISUALIZE
DRAW bar 
    MAPPING Country AS x, "Disaster Subgroup" AS fill
```
